title: Bahrain accuses Iran of attacking its territory to 'settle' score with US; Saudi Arabia joins condemnation
detail: Bahrain accused Iran of attacking its territory to settle a score with the United States, per Al Jazeera. Middle East Eye reports Saudi Arabia joined the condemnation of the Iranian attacks on Bahrain. Follows Iran's Nov 13 claim of striking a US radar site in Bahrain. Accounts are from the reporting outlets; Iran's response was not in the feed summary.
